thread:
Sam K: Heads up — perf-ci job for euw2 (A10) seq=32 workload regressed after merge 8f3a2c. Median latency +35% vs yesterday. Rollout paused. Anyone digging in?
Anika R: saw p95 spike on us-west L4 too, but spikes mainly for short sequences <=64. :thinking:
ci-bot: perf-ci/seq32-euw2 #412 FAILED — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/412 :warning:
Eva L: quick profile from the failing job attached below — looks like kernel selection flipped on A10 and we're falling back to generic matmul attn for many calls.
```text
kernel_selection:
  preferred: fused_attn_v2
  chosen:   generic_matmul_attn
reason: kv_cache_size > 2GB -> fused kernel disabled (threshold change)
```
Marco P: I bisected this morning — commit 8f3a2c adjusted the kernel selection heuristics (L2 threshold tuning). Bisect log:
```bash
git bisect start
git bisect good HEAD~12
git bisect bad HEAD
# bisected to 8f3a2c
```
Anika R: correlating metrics — KV hit rate on euw2 went from ~98% -> ~73% around the same time (evictions spiked). That matches more fallback work being done + extra kernel overhead.
Ops-bot: euw2-a10-17 showed a short NIC retransmit blip (1.2%) at 12:14 UTC during the CI run, and rack spot-scheduler shows other jobs on same rack. Possible noisy neighbor but timing is fuzzy.
Marco P: I reproduced the regression on an isolated A10 devbox with single replica and deterministic input (no other tenants). So noisy neighbor is unlikely to be the root cause. Repro steps and perf trace attached.
Jay: Given the bisect, I'd recommend a targeted revert of 8f3a2c as a mitigation while we iterate on the heuristic. Can someone open the PR?
Sam K: +1 to revert. Plan: open revert PR, hold rollout, do a 5% canary on euw2 (A10 + L4) once reverted, collect med/p95 + KV hitrate for 30m. @oncall please watch the canary dashboards.
oncall: Ack — I'll watch latency, KV hitrate, and NIC counters. Will alert if anything abnormal.
Marco P: Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/892 (revert 8f3a2c). Also adding a short-run perf test matrix for seq=8/32/128 on A10/L4/H100.
Sam K: Can we run the canary command?
Eva L: Runbook command:
```bash
./deploy_canary --cluster euw2 --pct 5 --models all --tag revert-8f3a2c
# then watch: kubectl logs -l app=perf-ci -n perf --since=10m | grep latency
```
ci-bot: revert PR merged, perf-ci rerun #415 started.
ci-bot: perf-ci/seq32-euw2 #415 PASSED — median latency returned to baseline, KV hitrate back to ~97%.
Sam K: Unpause rollout after 45m of stable metrics and confirm with post-deploy checks. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Eva L: I'll follow up with a proposal to make kernel selection decision less sensitive to KV size and add a small unit test that simulates A10 cache pressure.
Marco P: Filing follow-up task to tune thresholds + add targeted perf tests across hardware: ENG-1357.
Jay: Revert PR and canary flow worked. Keeping a note to watch for L4 differences — H100 behavior looked fine in smoke runs.
ci-bot: Monitoring window complete — rollout unpaused.
